name: qa_perform
title: OS-FINALQA FQA-5a: Perform: the Shift key row, the FX list (OVERDRV, BITDEPTH), VOLUME / PANNING over the playing song, then the DJ page: CURVE, groups, fader pads, CUT / REP / ECHO, KILL, FILTER, LATCH, banks, tempo, TRANS, SCR, TAPE STOP, leaving the page; no file is written

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)

steps.say: OS-FINALQA FQA-5a: the Perform rows of docs/qa/catalogue/perform.md that keys, pads and the console reach. The slots page (QA-PRF-001, 015, 020, 021, 023), then the DJ page with the song playing (QA-PRF-100..140). By ear, by export compare and by pad feel are `manual:` in the catalogue. Needs t-v16. The AFFECTED tracks and the DJ groups are runtime state: a run on a unit that was not rebooted starts from the state the former run left (this one ends with the groups at THRU)

steps.note: RESET: every slot off

steps.say: QA-PRF-001: Shift held on Perform shows STORE 1..3 on F1..F3 and nothing on F4..F8; Shift + F7 does not fall through to NEXT PAT

steps.note: QA-PRF-001: the key row of the Shift layer against the simulator (soft)
QA-PRF-001: Shift + F7 does nothing (the plain F7 would say NOT PLAYING)

steps.say: QA-PRF-015: EDIT (Rec), slot 1 holds VOLUME by default: Down wraps to OVERDRV, Down again to BITDEPTH; both on the list in full and not dimmed

steps.note: QA-PRF-015: slot 1 reads OVERDRV in full, drawn like the other names
QA-PRF-015: slot 1 reads BITDEPTH in full
back to VOLUME
EDIT off

steps.say: QA-PRF-020 / 021 / 023: with the song playing, the AFFECTED tracks (Shift + the top row of pads) and VOLUME -100 (slot 1, row 1, pad 12, the encoder to the end, stored with Rec / EDIT on: a live value ends with the pad) silence the master; the stored silence survives Stop and Play; RESET brings it back; PANNING +100 (pad 13) lowers the left

steps.note: Song, not Pattern: Perform keeps its FX on Song only
T1..T12 join the performance layer (AFFECTED)
EDIT on: the encoder STORES the value in the row, so that it stays latched after the pad's release (QA-PRF-025: a live value ends with the pad, `PerformBank::pad_up`)
slot 1 (VOLUME), row 1 held
-100: the end of the range
QA-PRF-020: the master falls by at least 12 dB with VOLUME at -100 on every track
QA-PRF-020: the slot's value reads -100 (picture only)
EDIT off: the stored -100 stays (the header reads `latched until another row`)
Song, not Pattern: Perform keeps its FX on Song only
QA-PRF-023: still silent after Stop and Play (the stored value is latched; the performance layer is its own, the tracker's volume reset does not undo it)
RESET
QA-PRF-023: RESET brings the master back
slot 2 (PANNING), row 1 held
QA-PRF-021: (soft: the left falls when every track is moved to the right; the picture and the ear are the check)
QA-PRF-021: the PANNING slot's value (picture only)
RESET

steps.say: QA-PRF-100: the DJ page opens (page 1): PAGE DJ, CURVE SMOOTH, twelve THRU boxes, the key row
QA-PRF-103: F3 toggles CURVE SMOOTH / CUT

steps.note: CUT

steps.say: QA-PRF-104: Shift + a pad of row 1 cycles a track THRU, A, B, THRU; then all twelve tracks go to A

steps.note: QA-PRF-104: every track to group A

steps.say: QA-PRF-101 / 102: the encoder moves the fader (six detents left, Shift = one position); pad 12 of row 4 jumps all B, which silences group A; pad 1 jumps back

steps.note: row 4, last pad: the fader all B
QA-PRF-102: group A (every track) is silent with the fader all B
row 4, first pad: all A
QA-PRF-102: and back at full with the fader all A

steps.say: QA-PRF-105: RESET centres the fader, the groups stay (the master is at the centre's -3 dB, not silent)
QA-PRF-125 / 123 / 124: CUT A (row 2, pad 6 = pad 17) silences group A while held; REP 1/16 A (pad 3 = 14) and ECHO A (pad 5 = 16) light their pads

steps.note: QA-PRF-125: group A is silent while CUT is down
QA-PRF-125: the pad is bright
QA-PRF-125: and back at the release
QA-PRF-123: REP 1/16 of A lit while down
QA-PRF-123: dim at the release
QA-PRF-124: ECHO of A lit while down (the strip may say DELAY LEVEL IS 0: then the master delay level is 0)

steps.say: QA-PRF-126 / 140: LATCH (F6) keeps a row 2 pad, RESET ends it and keeps LATCH

steps.note: QA-PRF-140
QA-PRF-126: the REP pad stays lit after the release
QA-PRF-126: RESET ends it

steps.say: QA-PRF-115 / 116 / 117: KILL pads (row 3, pads 1..3 = 24..26) light while down; with LATCH a tap keeps MID, a second tap ends it, RESET ends a kill

steps.note: QA-PRF-115: LOW and HI kills lit
QA-PRF-116: MID stays after the tap (LATCH on)
QA-PRF-116: the second tap ends it
QA-PRF-117: RESET ends a latched kill

steps.say: QA-PRF-111 / 112 / 113: the filter, LATCH on: F4 held + the encoder five detents left, let go of F4, the filter stays; RESET clears it; the FILT pad (pad 4 of row 3 = 27) is the filter too

steps.note: FILTER LP 50 LATCH
FILTER OFF, LATCH still on
QA-PRF-113: the FILT pad is bright while the filter is away from 0
LATCH off again

steps.say: QA-PRF-109 / 110: LATCH off: F4 held + the encoder three detents right reads HP 30, the release springs back to OFF

steps.note: FILTER HP 30
FILTER OFF

steps.say: QA-PRF-118 / 119 / 120: the pattern row and the bank keys; a tap on a pad of row 1 queues that pattern, a second tap cancels

steps.note: NOW PAT n, NEXT -, BANK 1
BANK 2, patterns 13..24
QA-PRF-119: pattern 2 of bank 1 queued
NEXT PAT 2 and the pad blinks
the second tap cancels

steps.say: QA-PRF-121 / 122: Right held nudges the tempo while playing (the tempo of `state` moves, then returns); Shift + Right / Left move the project tempo by 0.1 BPM and back

steps.note: QA-PRF-121: the nudged tempo differs while Right is down (soft: it follows the sequencer's publish)
NUDGE +4%
QA-PRF-121: the tempo is back at the release
QA-PRF-122: +0.1 BPM
QA-PRF-122: and back to the first value

steps.say: QA-PRF-129 / 131 / 132: TRANS HP (row 3, pad 5 = 28) and TRANS ECHO (pad 7 = 30) start a transition, any TRANS pad cancels it

steps.note: (TRANS HP n %) in the NEXT line
QA-PRF-132: the second tap cancels (soft: a refusal such as PATTERN IS NOT IN THE SONG says why none started)
QA-PRF-131: (TRANS ECHO ARMED)

steps.say: QA-PRF-133 / 138: SCR makes the encoder the platter, F5 again ends it; RESET with SCR on ends it. QA-PRF-136: TAPE STOP (row 3, pad 8 = 31) stops the mix while held

steps.note: SCR on
QA-PRF-138: RESET ends the scratch
QA-PRF-136: the mix is stopped while TAPE STOP is held
QA-PRF-136
QA-PRF-136: live again at the release

steps.say: QA-PRF-106: the Song restarts at order 14 (patterns 8, 9, 9, 2: at least 4 tracks sound for 40 s) so that the check below does not fall on pattern 5, which holds T01 only

steps.note: the cursor on order 14

steps.say: QA-PRF-106 / 114 / 117 / 127: leaving the page ends every DJ effect: fader all B, LATCH on, CUT A latched, then the slots page: the master is back, and the DJ page finds no LATCH

steps.note: QA-PRF-106: group A is cut by the fader and the latched CUT

steps.say: QA-PRF-106 / 114 / 127: the master sounds again on the slots page (the fader, the CUT and LATCH ended)

steps.note: QA-PRF-114: LATCH was off when the page came back, so F6 turns it ON
FILTER OFF, the fader at the centre
the groups are back to THRU (two more taps each: B, THRU)

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
